title: Oven-Roasted Slovakian Cucumber Stir-fry
description: A flavorful and refreshing Slovakian-inspired dish featuring tender oven-roasted cucumbers, stir-fried with garlic and served with crusty bread.

ingredients.name: 4 large cucumbers
ingredients.notes: Select firm, unblemished cucumbers for this recipe.

ingredients.name: 2 cloves garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic adds depth to this dish without overpowering the cucumbers.

ingredients.name: 1 large onion
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice the onion to prevent it from overpowering the dish.

ingredients.name: 2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill
ingredients.notes: Fresh herbs add a bright, refreshing flavor to this dish.

ingredients.name: 1 teaspoon paprika
ingredients.notes: Smoked paprika adds a smoky depth to this dish, but sweet paprika can be used as a substitute.

ingredients.name: 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
ingredients.notes: Freshly ground black pepper enhances the flavors of the dish without overpowering them.

ingredients.name: 4 slices of bread
ingredients.notes: Serve the cucumber stir-fry with crusty bread for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: 1 large tomato (optional)
ingredients.notes: Diced tomato adds a pop of color and flavor, while chopped chives add a fresh, oniony flavor.

instructions: Cut the cucumbers into 1/2-inch thick slices and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the cucumbers and sprinkle with salt, paprika, and black pepper.
Bake the cucumbers in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
While the cucumbers are baking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the sliced onion and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until it begins to caramelize.
Add the white wine vinegar and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the onion is tender and the liquid has evaporated.
Stir in the chopped fresh herbs and cook for 1 minute, or until wilted.
Once the cucumbers are done baking, remove them from the oven and let them cool slightly.
Add the roasted cucumbers to the skillet with the onion and herbs, and stir to combine.
Serve the cucumber stir-fry hot, garnished with chopped fresh chives and a side of crusty bread.
